remarks: Luxury 2-bedroom 2-bathroom condo in an incredible West Norwalk location! - Updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances - Two oversized bedrooms, with an en-suite bath and large walk-in closet in master bedroom - Second full bathroom in hallway - Open concept living/dining room with built-in shelving and gas fireplace! - Laminate flooring throughout - Laundry in-unit - TWO assigned garage spaces + storage unit in garage! - Elevator building with easy access to both your garage and apartment - Serene outdoor common space with large courtyard + picnic area situated on the Five Mile River - Located just around the corner from Route 1, I-95, and the Darien/Norwalk border for an easy commute! - Pets considered on a case-by-case basis, excellent credit required
